String.string:
[EN] The creator is with us.
[ES] El creador está con nosotros.

[EN] Your soul screams in anguish.
[ES] Tu alma grita de angustia.

[EN] The sound of enraged screaming fills the air.
[ES] El sonido de gritos furiosos llena el aire.

[EN] Guardian? Of what? Who do you guard?
[ES] ¿Guardián? ¿De qué? ¿A quién guardas?

[EN] How can you call yourself a Guardian when you're soaked in blood?
[ES] ¿Cómo puedes llamarte Guardián cuando estás empapado en sangre?

[EN] Do you feel the guilt? The fury?
[ES] ¿Sientes la culpa? ¿La furia?

[EN] You will never leave this place!
[ES] ¡Nunca saldrás de este lugar!

[EN] All of this... it's only in your mind.
[ES] Todo esto... solo está en tu mente.

[EN] I should have lived...
[ES] Debería haber vivido...

[EN] I give my soul... to you...
[ES] Entrego mi alma... a ti...

[EN] Why didn't you save me?
[ES] ¿Por qué no me salvaste?

[EN] Die! Die! Die!
[ES] ¡Muere! ¡Muere! ¡Muere!

[EN] I was too young to die... it's all because of you!
[ES] Era demasiado joven para morir... ¡todo es por tu culpa!

[EN] My money... all gone... because of you!
[ES] Mi dinero... todo perdido... ¡por tu culpa!

[EN] Feel what it's like to be hopeless.
[ES] Siente lo que es estar sin esperanza.

[EN] Neck Slice!
[ES] ¡Neck Slice!

[EN] Your thoughts turn ominous!
[ES] ¡Tus pensamientos se vuelven siniestros!

[EN] Behind you! Watch out!
[ES] ¡Detrás de ti! ¡Cuidado!

[EN] Mystel's Blessing decreases your cooldown for Apex skills.
[ES] Mystel's Blessing reduce tu tiempo de reutilización para habilidades Apex.

[EN] Only an Apex skill can conquer your Temper.
[ES] Solo una habilidad Apex puede conquistar tu Temper.

[EN] Only an Apex skill can master your Self-Doubt.
[ES] Solo una habilidad Apex puede dominar tu Self-Doubt.

[EN] Only an Apex skill can banish your Guilt.
[ES] Solo una habilidad Apex puede desterrar tu Guilt.

[EN] You acquired Apex glyphs.
[ES] Adquiriste glifos Apex.

[EN] Look upon the core of your Temper.
[ES] Contempla el núcleo de tu Temper.

[EN] Look upon the core of your Self-Doubt.
[ES] Contempla el núcleo de tu Self-Doubt.

[EN] Look upon the core of your Guilt.
[ES] Contempla el núcleo de tu Guilt.

[EN] Overcome your Temper.
[ES] Supera tu Temper.

[EN] Overcome your Self-Doubt.
[ES] Supera tu Self-Doubt.

[EN] Overcome your Guilt.
[ES] Supera tu Guilt.

[EN] Confront your Aggravation again, when you're ready.
[ES] Enfrenta tu Aggravation de nuevo, cuando estés listo.

[EN] Address your Indecision again, when you're ready.
[ES] Aborda tu Indecision de nuevo, cuando estés listo.

[EN] Acknowledge your Responsibilty again, when you're ready.
[ES] Reconoce tu responsabilidad de nuevo cuando estés listo.

[EN] You feel a growing confidence.
[ES] Sientes una confianza creciente.

[EN] You feel an overwhelming strength building deep within your soul.
[ES] Sientes una fuerza abrumadora formándose en lo más profundo de tu alma.

[EN] You have awakened.
[ES] Has despertado.

[EN] You feel your inner strength becoming unstoppable.
[ES] Sientes que tu fuerza interior se vuelve imparable.

[EN] You have acquired all Apex skills.
[ES] Has adquirido todas las habilidades Apex.

[EN] You acquired Apex glyphs.
[ES] Adquiriste glifos Apex.

[EN] You acquired an Apex title.
[ES] Has adquirido un título Apex.
